content: Umi yargeb Murdaxay x marra min ittwaggen, icarreg tcamir nnes, yarḍ ict n txancet issuyes iɣɣeḍ x uzeǧif nnes uca iẓwa di řwesṭ n tendint, tuɣa issɣuyyu ict n tɣuyyit tejhed tarzeg.
Yiweḍ-dd ař tawwart n ujeǧid, minzi war iɛeddeř i uřa d ijj maḥend ad yadef ɣar tewwart n ujeǧid am yarḍ txancet n wecḍan.
Di kuř lɛamala d kuř tandint mani yiweḍ řumur n ujeǧid, iřqef Udayen ijj n wecḍan d ameqqran d uẓummi d imeṭṭawen d iɣuyyan, uca qqimen aṭṭas zzaysen ẓẓřen di txancet n wecḍan d yiɣɣeḍ.

Timsexxarin timeẓyanin n Istir d imsexxaren nnes icennɛen usin-dd maḥend ad tt xebbaren s uya uca teḥzen tjeǧidt aṭṭas. Tessekk tcamirat i Murdaxay maḥend ad tent yarḍ, ad ikkes taxancet nnes n wecḍan, maca netta war tent iqbiř.
Xenni třaɣa Istir i Hatax, ijj zeg imsexxaren icennɛen n ujeǧid, wenni tuɣa i d as igga ujeǧid d amsexxar, uca tumur i-t x Murdaxay maḥend ad tessen min t yuɣin d mayemmi igga ammu.
Iffeɣ Hattax ɣar Murdaxay, ɣar wazzay i iǧan zzat i tewwart n ujeǧid,
uca Murdaxay iɛawed as marra min d as imsaren d cḥař n nnuqart i iwaɛed Haman ad t iwzen i ixxamen n txubay n ujeǧid di ṭṭweɛ n ureddeǧ n Wudayen.

Netta iwca as ict n tiřemt n tira n uzerf i ittwassuffɣen di Cucan maḥend ad ten areddǧen, ḥima ad tt isscen i Istir u ad as yini u ad as yumur maḥend ad traḥ ɣar ujeǧid ad as tzawg u maḥend ad as tᵉttar zzat i wudem nnes di ṭṭweɛ n řgens nnes.
Yudef Hatax uca iɛawed awařen n Murdaxay i Istir.
Tessiweř Istir i Hatax uca tumur i-t ad yini i Murdaxay:

“Marra imsexxaren n ujeǧid d marra řgens di lɛamalat n ujeǧid ssnen mliḥ belli marra wi ɣa yadfen ɣar ujeǧid deg wazzay n zzat, am war dd-ittwařaɣa, d aryaz niɣ d tamɣart i iǧa, aqa din xas ijj n řeḥkam waha, d řmewt, mɣir mařa ajeǧid isswiẓẓeḍ as azeǧaḍ nnes n wureɣ, ḥima ad iqqim iddar. Třatin n wussan-a i iɛdun war xafi dd-iřaɣa ḥed maḥend ad dd-aseɣ ɣar ujeǧid.”
Ɛawden nitni awařen n Istir i Murdaxay.
Xenni inna Murdaxay, ad inin i Istir ɛawed: “War txemmam, aqa cem tzemmared ad tarewřed di taddart n ujeǧid, ktar x marra Wudayen nneɣni.

Minzi mařa cem tesseɣded s tidett di řweqt-a, ad din tiři řefsaset d usellek i Wudayen zeg webrid nneɣni, maca cem d taddart n babam ad ttwareddǧen. Wi issnen ma teksid aweqqar igellden ɣar ict n řweqt am tanita?”
Xenni inna Istir, ittxeṣṣa ad dd-arren x Murdaxay:

“Uyur, smun marra Udayen i izeddɣen di Cucan uca ẓummem ayi i necc, war tᵉttem, war tsessem třata n wussan, ǧiřet d wass. Uřa d necc d temsexxarin inu timeẓyanin ad ẓumment ammu, uca xenni ad adfeɣ ɣar ujeǧid min war icuwwar ɛlaḥsab azerf. Mařa fniɣ, xenni fniɣ!”
Xenni iffeɣ Murdaxay uca igga am mammec marra min x i d as tumur Istir.
